Name: Kent Gets Therapy - 3 Heart Event Edit
Author: AirynS
Description:
A small mod that edits Kent’s 3 heart event to have better, more poignant writing and a more satisfying conclusion where Kent realises that he needs to start seeing a therapist. Originally written to be included as part of [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url], but it was split off into its own mod for people who would like this event edit without the larger mod. Although it doesn't explicitly refer to ShotFromGun's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4217]No More War - Kent As Journalist[/url], the edits are written so that the event can be seen as compatible lore-wise.

To install, simply extract the “[CP] Kent Gets Therapy - 3 Heart Event Edit” folder and drop it into your Mods folder.

This mod is i18n-compatible, so if anyone would like to translate it, please send me a copy of the translated default.json and I'll gladly add it with credit!
- Thanks to Herienseo for the Chinese translation!
- Thanks to Mazout for the French translation!

For anyone who would like to see the new text before downloading, click on the spoiler box:
[spoiler]
[b]Jodi[/b]: Hi, [Player]! I'm just making some popcorn.
[b]Kent[/b]: Jodi! They're shooting, get down!
[b]Kent[/b]: Wha... Jodi, what's going on? Are the boys safe?
[b]Kent[/b]: I thought that the war had followed me home, that the Gotoro soldiers were attacking. ...Just the noise was enough to make me feel like I was back in the empire again.
[b]Jodi[/b]: I thought it might make you feel better to enjoy your old favorites again. Remember when we used to make popcorn and watch movies with the boys?
[b]Kent[/b]: It feels like that was a lifetime ago...
[b]Jodi[/b]: *whisper* [Player]... can you say something to him? Times like these, he gets so caught up in his head that he doesn't hear me, and I don't know how to get through to him.
(Say something?)

﻿> [b]Player[/b]: Jodi, you should've known better.
[b]Kent[/b]: No, she's not the one with the problem.

﻿> [b]Player[/b]: I know you're hurting, Kent. You should talk to someone about it.
[b]Kent[/b]: ... You're right, [Player]. I've been avoiding thinking about it, but it's not helping.

﻿> [b]Player[/b]: (Lie) Blame me... I told Jodi to make popcorn.
[b]Kent[/b]: Don't lie to me, [Player]. Jodi and I will sort this out ourselves.

[b]Kent[/b]: ...Sorry, honey. I know I've been scaring you with my behavior. I... I think it's time I talked to a professional about all this.
[b]Jodi[/b]: Oh, Kent... I'm so proud of you, dear. We can speak to Doctor Harvey about it when you're ready.
[b]Kent[/b]: I'll look into therapy options together with Jodi. I'm glad you're a friend of the family, [Player].
[/spoiler]
